instruction.text: 7 years ago, Sandra planted an apple tree in her garden and recorded its growth. This graph shows how many metres the apple tree has grown over 7 years. Look at the graph and answer the questions.

atoms.a: How tall was the apple tree in year 4?
How tall was the apple tree after 7 years?
atoms.b: The apple tree was <mat><gap>9</gap></mat> metres tall.

atoms.a: After how many years did the apple tree stop growing?
atoms.b: The apple tree stopped growing after <mat><gap>6</gap></mat> years.

atoms.a: When was the apple tree exactly 3 metres tall?
atoms.b: The apple tree was exactly 3 metres tall in year 2.

atoms.a: How tall was the apple tree after 5 years?
atoms.b: The apple tree was <mat><gap>8</gap></mat> metres tall.

atoms.a: How many metres did the apple tree grow from year 2 to year 6?
atoms.hint: To figure out the difference between two points, subtract the height in metres in year 6 from the height in metres in year 2.

instruction.text: Anna ran a 100-metre sprint for her school. This time graph shows how fast she ran. Fill out the table using the graph.
